content.summary: The repaired displays preserve the mathematical claims. I inspected actual F34 page images 2–6, compared the six explicit mappings with the manuscript, and verified their manifest hashes. The small-L exceptions and finite-obstruction wording remain logically sound; no constructive repair is required.

checks.scope: Display repair and exceptional quadratic cases
checks.method: Visually compared pages 2–5 and exact formula mappings; evaluated the exceptional quadratic values.
checks.observation: The six mapped displays retain inequality directions, summation squares, triple subtraction, and equivalence wording. The small-L values of L²-3L are 0,-2,-2; those of L²-6L are 0,-5,-8,-9,-8,-5. Nonnegative binomial sums therefore suffice without invalid low-range monotonicity. The source-style numbered formulas remain readable.

checks.method: Read page 6 and compared its statement and relabeling proof with the literal formal interface previously inspected.
checks.observation: Exactly 28 members and four-element subsets of Fin 53 describe the correct obstruction; full use of all 53 points is not required. Both implication directions are explained, and nonexistence remains an obligation rather than an asserted conclusion.
